data_fields.name: hit_xp_share_rule
data_fields.donor_constant: loot xp x health removed / victim max health

best_idea: Award a unit's XP per hit as its loot value times the share of its max health that hit removed, then promote through as many tiers as the carried XP pays for, in one loop.
decision_why: The per-hit damage-share award and the tier carry-over fit a 3-attacker fight and a server ledger; the passive trickle timer and the entity-template swap do not fit (passive XP is not a server-verified kill; tiers are data, not templates).
acceptance: A server test with a victim of 100 loot XP and 120 max HP: a 60-HP hit credits 50 XP; a second hit worth 65 XP leaves the attacker at tier 1 with 15 XP carried; a status-effect tick credits 0 XP.
